sources: Google Maps place 'Toodik Family Campground Cabin & Canoeing' (read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Per night for 1-2 persons and one vehicle: water/electric $37 (20A), $39 (30A), $42 (50A); full hookup $42 (30A), $43 (50A); primitive $34. Extra adults $10, children 4-17 $4. Weekly 6 nights with the 7th free ($222-258).

fees.source: https://camptoodik.com/camp/ ('Camping Rates ... Prices are per night and are for 1-2 persons / one vehicle': W / E 20 Amp $37 ... Full hookup 50 Amp $43), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://camptoodik.com/camp/ ('W / E 50 Amp $42', 'Full hookup 50 Amp $43') + site map colour key ('Full Hookup/Electric 50A'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Sites numbered to 223 on the park map, many marked seasonal. The riverside row (209-220) is water/electric 30A transient; 202-208 on the river are seasonal. Camping clubs: sites for 40-ft motorhomes.

sites.source: https://camptoodik.com/wp-content/uploads/Camp-Toodik-Site-Map-8.5x11_Page_1.jpg (site numbers 1-223, colour key 'Pink Seasonal Sites', 'Gray Water/Electric 30A') + https://camptoodik.com/camp/ ('We offer sites allowing 40′ MH RV’s'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Heated swimming pool, miniature golf, canoe livery.

facilities.source: https://camptoodik.com/wp-content/uploads/Camp-Toodik-Site-Map-8.5x11_Page_1.jpg (buildings key: 'Restrooms & Showers' x3, 'Dump Station', 'Laundromat', 'Registration - Store', 'Heated Swimming Pool') + https://camptoodik.com/, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations suggested but not always needed; a $40 per-site deposit guarantees one, cancellations 7 days ahead. Check-in 4-9 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://camptoodik.com/camp/ ('All Holidays are 3 night minimum stay'; 'Reservations are suggested – but may not always be needed'; 'Your credit card will be charged $40 per site to guarantee the reservation'), read 2026-10-30; no online booking link on the site

note: 93 acres. Main Hill full-hookup and River Edge water/electric RV sites fronting the Lake Fork (Mohican) branch. --Claude
summary: Rates read from the camp page: $37-43 for 1-2 people (W/E 20A to FHU 50A; primitive $34). Confirmed water/sewer and 223 sites; added 50-amp, showers/flush/dump/laundry/store, phone reservations with a holiday 3-night minimum. Site map confirms the riverside row 209-220 is transient W/E 30A. Note trimmed of figures now in fields (acreage kept).
flags: Google Maps: 4.2 from 220 reviews (Toodik Family Campground Cabin & Canoeing, phone +1 419-994-3835, site camptoodik.com).

Presence/price: own website with posted 2026 rates, $37-43/night for 2 - well under $50. Long-stay tests pass: nightly and weekly rates posted, transient sites throughout; pink seasonal sites on the map are a minority (roughly a third).
Pin ~280 m off: stored 40.6326,-82.1874 is at Township Rd 462 by the entrance, west of the camp; the campground body centres near 40.6312,-82.1844 (river row near 40.6293,-82.1814).
